extracted.intended_audience: Researchers and organizations (academic institutions, nonprofits, and for‑profit companies) seeking ONR funding
extracted.subtask_description: Preparing and submitting proposals (technical and cost) in response to ONR Broad Agency Announcements (BAAs), NOFOs, and CSOs for Navy and Marine Corps science & technology funding, following ONR templates, deadlines, and policies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Standardized proposal template requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Required: All BAAs incorporate a standardized template for the submission of technical and cost proposals for all contract awards.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the standardized form and spreadsheet provided with each BAA; ONR provides 'Download the Forms'. Guidance and assistance in completing the form and spreadsheet can be obtained from points of contact provided in the BAA.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide technical and contracting points of reference
rubrics_metrics.description: Each announcement provides technical and contracting points of reference.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consult the announcement for the technical scope and contracting references that frame proposal preparation and evaluation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Conflicts of Interest policy
rubrics_metrics.description: To ensure fairness in the consideration of proposals, ONR has implemented policies to protect against organizational conflicts of interest.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposers must be aware of and comply with ONR COI policies described in the announcement; failure to address COI issues may affect consideration.

rubrics_metrics.name: Eligibility and mission fit: innovative solutions addressing Navy/Marine Corps requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: ONR is constantly looking for innovative scientific and technological solutions to address current and future Navy and Marine Corps requirements. We want to do business with educational institutions, nonprofit and for‑profit organizations with ground‑breaking ideas, pioneering scientific research and novel technology developments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposals should demonstrate novelty, technical merit, and relevance to Navy/Marine Corps S&T needs; target organizations include academia, nonprofits, and industry.

rubrics_metrics.name: Adhere to published deadlines
rubrics_metrics.description: Full Proposals will be accepted until the deadline shown on each announcement (examples on page: 'Full Proposals will be accepted until: September 30, 2026 2:00 PM EST', 'May 01, 2026 4:00 PM EST', etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submit complete proposals by the stated date/time for each announcement; check the specific BAA/NOFO/CSO for exact cutoff and any updates.
